records.scope: 大量調理施設衛生管理マニュアル; do not universalize all numeric values as statute for every dish/restaurant
records.verified: Core 75℃ for at least1minute; norovirus-risk foods85–90℃ for at least90seconds or equivalent. Manual cooling target near20℃ within30min or near10℃ within60min. Manual holding10℃or lower/65℃or higher.
Accurate up-to-date food-allergy information matters; communicate confirmed ingredients and cross-contact limitations rather than guaranteeing safety from an old fixed list.

FDMA prioritizes early evacuation and smoke avoidance. Police discusses hotel evacuation bags with explicit suffocation caution; this does not justify a generic instruction for untrained learners to put arbitrary bags over their faces.
records.decision: Omit generic bag-over-face and blanket-on-fryer instructions; teach alarm, safe evacuation and site-specific trained response. Do not label historical source universally false.

records.verified: Anisakis control: freeze at -20℃ for at least24hours or heat70℃or higher, or60℃for at least1minute; do not substitute vinegar, salt or wasabi. These conditions target the parasite, not every microbial hazard.
